name: ECA Breadcrumbs
description: Provides ECA events and actions for breadcrumb customization with token support.
project_description: ECA Breadcrumbs registers a breadcrumb builder service that dispatches an ECA "Build breadcrumb" event on every route, letting site builders redefine the breadcrumb trail from an ECA model instead of writing PHP. Two ECA actions populate the trail: "Breadcrumb: add item" appends a single Title/URL link, and "Breadcrumb: set items" replaces the whole trail from a multi-line Title|URL list. Both accept Drupal tokens in titles and URLs; route parameters (nodes, users, taxonomy terms) are automatically registered as ECA token data before replacement, so tokens such as [node:title] resolve against the current page. URLs may be internal paths (/products), absolute external URLs, or route names, and an empty URL renders the item as the non-linked current page. If an ECA model sets no items, the builder yields to Drupal's default breadcrumb builders. The module also exposes a [breadcrumb:route-name] token and ships a pipeline-identifier action and condition for coordinating multiple breadcrumb models. Depends on ECA and Token; no permissions, routes, Drush commands, or settings form of its own.
